results.title: Who is a famous Krishna singer?
results.snippet: Krishna Das (IAST: Kṛṣṇa dāsa; born Jeffrey Kagel; May 31, 1947) is an American vocalist known for his performances of Hindu devotional music known as kirtan (chanting the names of God). He has released seventeen albums since 1996.

results.title: Who is the best speaker of ISKCON?
results.snippet: Gaur Gopal Das. Gaur Gopal Das (IAST: Gaura-Gopāla dāsa; born 24 December 1973) is an Indian monk, motivational speaker, and former electrical engineer. He is a member and preacher of the International Society for Krishna Consciousness (ISKCON).
